extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers or prospective editors who want to create a new article (potential/new Wikipedia contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia page, including account requirements, checks to avoid duplicate pages, and troubleshooting steps if a title is missing or was deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed status required
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create pages immediately, ensure you are logged in and meet Wikipedia's autoconfirmed status (account age and edit-count requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack permissions or are unsure about formatting/notability, submit a draft through the article wizard or use the 'request a new article' process so experienced editors can assist or review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles and alternative titles before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Comedy Hollywood 2020s' in existing articles. Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings and existing coverage to avoid creating duplicates. Use the search function and inspect pages that link to the intended title to see if the topic already exists under another name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check case sensitivity and consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new title, verify capitalization variants and create or request redirects from alternate spellings so readers find the content under expected names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for recent-creation delays and use purge if needed
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a page to exist but cannot see it, wait briefly for propagation or use the purge action to refresh the page cache.

rubrics_metrics.name: If a page is missing because it was deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log entries and explanatory help pages to understand deletion reasons; follow guidance there if you plan to recreate content (addressing notability, sourcing, or other deletion causes).
